title: Close the Loop on the Retrievability Gap
abstract: arXiv:2611.28146v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A frozen vision-language encoder now guides image restoration and later indexes what it produced. Over a fixed set of eighteen pansharpening systems on one WorldView-III test set, the fidelity index that ranks them, $Q2^n$ with a reference and HQNR without one, picks the less retrievable of two systems one time in three and one in two; the disagreement lies between the pixel-supervised and the language-conditioned family, and even the best system falls short of the reference, small objects first. We call this the retrievability gap and trace it to the area weighting of position-averaged losses. LEDGER closes the loop around the encoder: it indexes the input into a set of named concepts, generates, re-encodes the output alone with the same frozen encoder, and minimises a set-level soft-Jaccard loss on the coverage of that set, a label-free target available at test time, so that every present concept of a scale receives a gradient share

translated_title: 弥合可检索性差距的闭环
translated_abstract: 冻结的视觉-语言编码器如今既用于指导图像恢复，又在事后对其生成的结果进行索引。在单一WorldView-III测试集上对固定的十八种全色锐化系统进行评估时，衡量保真度的指标——有参考的$Q2^n$和无参考的HQNR——有三分之一的概率、甚至二分之一的概率会选择两个系统中可检索性较差的那一个；这种分歧主要存在于像素监督方法族与语言条件方法族之间，而且即使是最佳系统也未能达到参考水平，小目标首当其冲。我们将这一现象称为“可检索性差距”，并将其根源追溯到位置平均损失中的面积加权问题。LEDGER围绕编码器构建了闭环：它将输入索引为一组命名概念，进行图像生成，随后仅使用同一个冻结编码器对输出进行重新编码，并在该概念集合的覆盖率上最小化集合级软Jaccard损失——这是一个在测试时即可获得、无需标签的优化目标，从而确保每个尺度上出现的每个概念都能获得相应的梯度份额。
tldr: 本文揭示了全色锐化领域中保真度指标与下游检索性能之间的“可检索性差距”，并提出LEDGER方法，通过测试时无需标签的集合级软Jaccard损失围绕冻结视觉-语言编码器构建闭环，使每个概念都获得梯度贡献，从而弥合这一差距。
en_tdlr: Identifies the "retrievability gap" where fidelity metrics frequently favor less retrievable pansharpening systems, and proposes LEDGER, which closes the loop around a frozen vision-language encoder by minimizing a label-free set-level soft-Jaccard loss on concept coverage at test time.
